messages:
Lena: dropping a strange-but-real scenario for prompt-set approval UX. users want a fast 'Approve all visible' but also need a clear way to undo or inspect what changed. thinking: 2-stage commit vs immediate commit + 20s undo. figma: https://figma.redwood/approve-fast:eyes:
Omar: if we do immediate + undo, SR must announce the snackbar and not steal focus. undo window needs to be visible and persistent for screenreaders.
Priya: agree. accessibility rules: aria-live=polite on the snackbar, and when user presses Undo, SR should announce "Approvals reverted". Also give the snackbar a keyboard-focusable undo button.
Devon: performance question: if someone approves 5k items, we chunk commits server-side. how does undo interact with chunking? we need a revert endpoint that accepts a list of chunk-ids. backend note: support for idempotent revert exists but will need an ops flag for large batches.
Harper: copy nit: instead of "Undo" maybe use "Revert approvals" for clarity in audit logs and SR announcements. shorter UI label could still be "Undo" but aria-label="Revert approvals for 4,312 items".
Lena: love that aria-label pattern. UX variant: modal for >2k items, snackbar for <=2k. Or always snackbar but escalate modal when any selected item has tag "blocked".
Omar: modal will block but gives room for a diff preview. could show a condensed list: prompt set name + sample before/after + owner. helpful for admins.
Priya: ensure modal traps focus and has descriptive heading. If modal opens, announce with aria-live assertive: "Approve confirmation: 4,312 items". Provide keyboard shortcuts: Enter = confirm, Esc = cancel.
Devon: telemetry: annotate events with path: approve-snackbar, approve-modal, revert-triggered, revert-completed, and include item_count. Also track time-to-revert to refine default undo window.
Harper: QA checklist: keyboard-only undo & modal confirm, SR announcement timing (snackbar and undo), partial revert when chunking, and permission edge cases (viewer cannot approve).
Lena: one more microcopy thought: confirm button should read "Approve results (4,312)" and secondary "Cancel". show "View changes" link opens regression diff panel in background.
Omar: small UI tweak: make the snackbar persistent for 20s on desktop, 30s on mobile (users need more time on small devices). also add a subtle progress bar showing time left. ensure it doesn't auto-dismiss while focused.
Priya: aria example for the undo button: `<button aria-label="Revert approvals for 4,312 items" tabindex="0">Undo</button>` — and have aria-live="polite" text: "4,312 results approved. Press Undo to revert."
Devon: action items: I'll spec chunked-revert contract and telemetry events, Priya will write the a11y acceptance criteria, Harper to draft QA plan, Omar and Lena to prototype modal + snackbar variants. sync Friday 11am. :white_check_mark:
